classify.reason: The application's own adapter to Resolver: the WebAssembly guest has no network and FeltKit integrations cannot resolve through Resolver yet (FeltKit GAP-08), so this component is the only code that calls Resolver and holds its key.
A consuming application used by the e2e to prove a running consumer follows a governed change without restart.
Runs the change lifecycle through the compiled AppBoundry artifact.

The approval signer: a separate process that holds the change-authorization signing key, reads a change through this application as its own read-only principal, and signs only approved changes. Kept out of the application and its component by design (docs/AUTHORIZATION-INTEGRATION.md).

acknowledged.http-server:signer/server.ts: The approval signer must not run as this application's functions or component: it holds the signing key and must stay outside the trust boundary of the application it checks. A stateless HTTP endpoint (POST /sign) in its own process is the smallest form. See docs/AUTHORIZATION-INTEGRATION.md.
